items.text: Jatich Jehova Nyasaye
Winjauru un joma odak e dho nembe,
winjuru un pinje man mabor:
Kane pok onywola Jehova Nyasaye ne oluonga
koa e nywolna ne oluongo nyinga.
Ne omiyo lewa obedo ka ligangla mabith,
e bwo tipo mar lwete ne opanda;
ne omiyo abedo ka asere moywe maler
kendo ne opanda e olalone.
Ne owachona niya,
"In e jatichna, Israel, kuomi ema abiro nyisoe duongʼ mara."
To ne awacho ni, "Asetiyo matek kayiem nono;
aseketho tekra kayiem nono.
Kata kamano pokna ni e lwet Jehova Nyasaye
kendo michna Nyasacha ema nigo."
To koro Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama;
jal mane ochweya e ich mondo abed jatichne,
mondo adwok joka Jakobo kuome
kendo achok jo-Israel ire,
nimar aseyudo duongʼ e wangʼ Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo Nyasacha ema osebedo tekrena.
Owacho ni:
"En gima tin ahinya mondo ibed jatichna
kata mondo iduog dhood joka Jakobo,
kendo mondo iduog jo-Israel manok mane odongʼ.
Abiro miyo ibed ler mar ogendini,
mondo iter wach warruokna e tunge piny duto."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye,
ma Jares ji kendo Ngʼat Maler mar Israel wacho,
ne ngʼat mane ogendini ochayo
kendo ma en misumba jotend piny:
"Ruodhi nochungʼni malo koneni,
kendo jotelo koneno ma to nopodhni auma,
nikech Jehova Nyasaye, jal ma ja-adiera ma
en Ngʼat Maler mar Israel ema oseyieri."
Jo-Israel oduogi
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho,
"E ndalona mag kech abiro dwoko kwayoni,
chutho ne akonyi e odiechiengʼ mar warruok;
abiro riti mi ami ibed ngʼama kelo winjruok
e kinda gi ji mondo ires piny,
mi ipog ji kuonde ma yande odongʼ gunda,
kendo iwachne joma ni e twech ni, 'Wuoguru oko,'
to joma ni e mudho ni, 'Beduru thuolo!'
"Gibiro chiemo e bath yo
kendo giniyud kuonde kwath e gode matindo.
Kech ok nokagi kata riyo ok nologi,
bende liet mar kama otimo ongoro,
kata chiengʼ marieny makech ok nomigi olo.
Jal ma chunye opongʼ gi kech,
ema notelnigi mi tergi kuonde sokni mag pi.
Abiro loko godena duto yore
kendo anabug yorena madongo duto maber.
To ne, ginibi ka gia mabor;
moko kawuok yo nyandwat, moko kawuok yo yimbo,
moko to nowuogi e gwenge mag Aswan."
Go koko nikech mor, yaye polo, bed gi ilo,
yaye piny, weruru matek, un gode!
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye kweyo chuny joge
kendo obiro bedo gi kech ne joge machandore.
To Sayun nowacho niya,
"Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼa;
kendo Ruoth Nyasaye wiye osewil koda."
"To bende dhako wiye diwil gi nyathi modhodho
mi ok obedo gi kech e kothe mane onywolo.
Kata ka dipo ni wiye nyalo wil,
An to wiya ok nowil kodi.
Ne, asendiko nyingi ei lweta
kendo isiko ka ineno anena e wangʼa.
Yawuoti noreti kaduogo iri
kendo jogo manoyako gigi noringi kaduogo iri.
Tingʼ wangʼi malo kendo ingʼi koni gi koni:
mondo ine kaka yawuoti chokore kaduogo iri."
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya,
"Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon ni nyithindi nochal
gi thiwni madhako rwako kata ka law maber ma miaha rwako.
"Kata obedo ni osetieki midongʼ
gunda kendo pinyi odongʼ nono,
to koro ibiro yudo ni pinyi odoko matin ma ok oromo jogi dakie,
kendo jogo mane otieki biro bedo kodi mabor.
Nyithindo mane inywolo ka in e chandruok
nowachni kiwinjo ni,
Kaeni tin-nwa; dwarnwa kama lach mondo wadagie.
Eka inipenjri e chunyi ni,
'En ngʼa mane onywolona jogi?
Ne an gi kuyo kendo ne an migumba,
ne otera e twech kendo ojwangʼa.
En ngʼa manopidhogi?
Ne adongʼ kenda,
to jogi to oa kure?' "
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho:
"Winji, abiro luongo Ogendini,
abiro chungo bandecha ne oganda kaka ranyisi,
gibiro kelo yawuoti ka gitingʼogi e badgi
kendo ginikel nyigi ka gitingʼogi e gokgi.
Ruodhi ema nobed kaka wuoneu kendo mond ruodhi
ema nobed kaka mineu ma ritou.
Ginikulre auma e nyimu ka wengegi ngʼiyo piny;
kendo gininangʼ buru manie tiendu.
Eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye
kendo joma oketo genogi kuoma ok noyud wichkuot."
Bende dima jolweny maroteke gik ma giseyako,
koso dires joma otwe e lwet ngʼama kwiny?
To ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachoni:
"Ee, joma otwe inyalo gol e lwet jolweny maroteke,
kendo ngʼama omaki inyalo gamo e lwet joma kwiny;
anaked gi jogo makedo kodu,
kendo anares nyithindu.
Abiro miyo joma sandou nocham ringregi giwegi
mi anami gimer gi rembgi ka joma omadho kongʼo.
Eka koth dhano duto manie piny nongʼe
ni an Jehova Nyasaye e Jawarni,
Jaresni kendo Nyasaye Maratego mar Jakobo."
